coordinated_activities.activity: Waking up, washing face, brushing teeth and getting dressed
Preparing and eating breakfast, making a hot drink with the kettle
Packing work bag, checking phone for shift notes and putting on work shoes
Commuting to the hospital for the day shift
Working as a health care professional, seeing patients, recording notes and coordinating with the care team
Taking a short lunch break at work
Continuing patient care duties, updating charts and handing over tasks
Cooking and eating dinner, using the induction cooker and range hood
Clearing the table, washing dishes and loading the dishwasher
Putting work clothes into the washing machine and tidying up
Relaxing on the sofa, watching TV and browsing on the computer
Taking a shower and drying off
Winding down, setting an alarm on the phone and dimming the desk lamp
